# TerraGuard

> TerraGuard uses drone multispectral imaging and AI to detect powdery mildew, downy mildew, and crop stress in vineyards before visible symptoms appear.

## About

Powdery and downy mildew often begin developing before visible symptoms appear. By the time the first signs are noticeable, infections may already be spreading across a vineyard, making timely intervention more difficult.

TerraGuard combines high-resolution drone imagery with weather and environmental data. Its AI analyzes the vineyard and provides clear, actionable insights through an easy-to-use AI co-pilot. Scheduled multispectral flights are flown on a DJI Mavic 3 Multispectral; computer vision maps canopy stress and flags patterns linked to disease risk before symptoms are visible. Growers can ask about their vineyard in plain language and receive a recommended treatment window, the reasoning behind it, and a fallback if the weather shifts.

TerraGuard is built for commercial vineyards, wineries, vineyard managers, viticulturists, and agricultural consultants who want to improve grape quality, reduce unnecessary field inspections, and make better management decisions.

## What TerraGuard detects

- Early signs of fungal diseases, including powdery mildew and downy mildew (with additional diseases in development)
- Irrigation issues and water stress
- Nutrient deficiencies
- Vine health variability
- Areas that require closer field inspection

## Pilot program

TerraGuard works with a limited number of commercial vineyards each season to run the product in real vineyard conditions. Applications are reviewed individually.

- Apply: https://terraguard.ge/#pilot
